content:
**Spoiled Meat** is a consumable item in *Fallout 76*.

Spoiled Meat will appear in the player character's inventory whenever a piece of cooked or raw meat has fully rotted. It can be consumed raw, but the player character runs the risk of catching a disease. It may also be cooked into sausages and pies, removing the risk of disease.

Spoiled meat can also be converted into Raw Fertilizer at a Chemistry Station.

Replaces Meat products in the player character's inventory when it becomes spoiled.
